{{Quote|Solo's friend Fiolla's operation was located in Qatamer, which is the capital of the province of Kinyov and is considered the birthplace of modern Lorrdian culture.|Tash Arranda, ''Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break''|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />}}
'''Qatamer''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]], a [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the province of [[Kinyov]]. It had brightly painted buildings that stood out in the desert plains, with the few remaining [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] structures, made of sinister looking black stone.<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />

During the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], Qatamer became the headquarters of the [[Myrialites|Myrialite]] military occupation and slaving operations. It was home to [[Hart and Parn Starships]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Around this time, it was visited by Rebel operative [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], as well as [[Mammon Hoole]]. Tash Arranda later profiled Qatamer in her essay entitled ''[[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break]]''.<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />
